content:
**Thrilled to Share Some Exciting News! 🎉**

I'm honored to announce that I've officially joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**!

Having worked with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, this feels like a natural next step in a journey I'm deeply passionate about. I'm excited to contribute to moving this standard forward and helping shape the future of clinical decision support interoperability.

---

**A quick ask for the community:**

📣 If you're already using CDS Hooks in your organization, please consider adding your implementation to our availability list: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

Your visibility helps strengthen the ecosystem and demonstrates real-world adoption!

🤝 If you're exploring CDS Hooks but haven't implemented it yet, I'm available as a **freelance consultant** to help you navigate the process. Feel free to reach out—I'd love to help you get started.

Here's to advancing interoperability and smarter clinical decision support! 🚀

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #Interoperability #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthcareInnovation #FreelanceConsultant #HL7
